title: Week 4 Local Life and Repairs
objectives: Ask for help with basic repairs or services.
Talk about a problem clearly and simply.
Keep a practical conversation going when you do not understand every word.

activities.title: Describe a Problem
activities.instructions: Practice describing a leak, outage, or broken item using simple Spanish.

activities.title: Fast Local Reply
activities.instructions: Listen to a short rapid reply and identify the one detail you need to answer.

activities.title: Service Call
activities.instructions: Ask a contractor or service worker about timing, cost, and next steps.
